query:
SELECT id         AS "id!: Uuid",
                      user_id    AS "user_id!: Uuid",
                      provider   AS "provider!",
                      subject    AS "subject!",
                      email      AS "email?",
                      created_at AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM local_user_identities
               WHERE provider = $1 AND subject = $2
